items.name: Eta Combo
items.description: Test Eta's combo meal -- a main plus a side and a drink slot, both absorbing a standalone item at no extra charge up to the pack's own includedSize, then an upcharge for anything larger (#313, Rick's re-review item 2).

items.name: Eta Fries
items.description: Test Eta's only side, sized at the pack's own includedSize so absorbing it into a combo never carries an upcharge.

items.name: Eta Cola
